guidance.text: Guidance: Carbon life is best determined by pilot or RSSCT tests. Use theoretical calculation methods (e.g., Freundlich isotherms) only in the absence of such data for initial assessment of carbon life and suitability of GAC for treatment.

Guidance: EBCT is best determined by pilot tests, but may be calculated for radon if a steady state rate constant (Kss) is available. Use the theoretical calculation method for radon only in the absence of pilot data for initial assessment of EBCT and suitability of GAC for treatment.
Consider multiple vessels in series for long EBCTs (>10 minutes)
Different studies may use different defintions for "bed volumes." This assumption applies only when vessels are in series and the input for carbon life is in bed volumes.
• Bed volumes (BV) to breakthrough are calculated based on average flow and, where vessel are in series, total EBCT for the series
• “<dl” indicates that the specified compound was not detected in influent or detected only infrequently
• “no” indicates that the specified compound was detected in influent, but did not reach the specified breakthrough % (except as noted below)
• Blank cells indicate that the specified compound was not monitored
